el/#work"}},{"@type":"ListItem","position":24,"item":{"@id":"https://videha-ejournal.github.io/gajendra-preeti/works/sahasrabarhani-graphic-novel/#work"}},{"@type":"ListItem","position":25,"item":{"@id":"https://videha-ejournal.github.io/gajendra-preeti/works/a-parallel-history-of-mithila-and-maithili-literature/#work"}},{"@type":"ListItem","position":26,"item":{"@id":"https://videha-ejournal.github.io/gajendra-preeti/works/sahasrabarhani-maithili-braille-edition/#work"}},{"@type":"ListItem","position":27,"item":{"@id":"https://videha-ejournal.github.io/gajendra-preeti/works/akulait-sur-restless-notes/#work"}},{"@type":"ListItem","position":28,"item":{"@id":"https://videha-ejournal.github.io/gajendra-preeti/works/bijji-among-the-crocodiles/#work"}},{"@type":"ListItem","position":29,"item":{"@id":"https://videha-ejournal.github.io/gajendra-preeti/works/diwan-e-videha-khand-1/#work"}},{"@type":"ListItem","position":30,"item":{"@id":"https://videha-ejournal.github.io/gajendra-preeti/works/diwan-e-videha-khand-2/#work"}},{"@type":"ListItem","position":31,"item":{"@id":"https://videha-ejournal.github.io/gajendra-preeti/works/sahasrashirsha/#work"}},{"@type":"ListItem","position":32,"item":{"@id":"https://videha-ejournal.github.io/gajendra-preeti/works/sahasrabadhani/#work"}},{"@type":"ListItem","position":33,"item":{"@id":"https://videha-ejournal.github.io/gajendra-preeti/works/code-name-tarharime-gohi/#work"}},{"@type":"ListItem","position":34,"item":{"@id":"https://videha-ejournal.github.io/gajendra-preeti/works/nav-pankhi-new-wings/#work"}},{"@type":"ListItem","position":35,"item":{"@id":"https://videha-ejournal.github.io/gajendra-preeti/works/saatam-sakshi-the-seventh-witness/#work"}},{"@type":"ListItem","position":36,"item":{"@id":"https://videha-ejournal.github.io/gajendra-preeti/works/paatak-bhitar-likhal-naam-the-name-written-inside-the-leaf/#work"}}]}}]}1:[["$","$Lf",null,{}],["$","a",null,{"className":"skip","href":"#main","children":"मुख्य
